reviewMethod: Repeat model-blind (no detector scores or inference) assistant visual audit of 12 existing accepted positive sources in the old 96-recording manifest. Select lexicographically ascending SHA256 order among label-1 sources, then inspect each first eligible positive four-second window returned by unchanged generate_windows. All 1450 source frames covering selected intervals, including start predecessor/end successor when available, were directly inspected as 24 ordered contact sheets with view_image at original detail. Twelve enlarged full-frame sheets add 72 frame presentations; five targeted source-crop sheets add 30. All imagery comes from sequential OpenCV CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC reads, finite and strictly increasing, cv2.setNumThreads(1), one FFMPEG decoder and decoder thread at a time. Initial judgments were frozen before this audit opened selected prior review notes; afterward prior references and disagreements were appended. No audio, continuous playback, classifier predictions, model/GPU activity or training.
limitations: This is a second model-assisted review, not independent human ground truth. It repeats old training sources; it adds zero new sources and creates no independent holdout, calibration or new actor/session cohort.

Initial visual judgments were frozen before reading prior notes during this audit, but prior positive status and temporal event intervals were known to the unchanged window generator. An earlier turn in this same chat had displayed a prior note for v_c_b_9; that item is explicitly not fully blinded.

Every-frame static review is not continuous-motion playback, force/impact verification, intent, identity or injury evidence. Blur, occlusion, face masking and image resizing remain limitations. Ordered tiles are 240x135, enlarged full frames 720x405; five extra crops preserve aspect ratio but may omit peripheral context retained in full frames.

Only selected four-second windows were audited. Proposed events are conservative subsets of those windows, not full-source annotations, normal labels or automatic canonical training changes. Uncertain contact, gaps and tails remain unknown.

Supported means the proposed target-compatible contact intervals cover at least two seconds of the inspected four-second window under existing window_label. Uncertain short proposed intervals do not meet that threshold; unsupported prop-containing clips have empty proposedEvents and are not normal by inference.

Two source-end-aligned windows have declared ends beyond final decoded PTS by roughly one frame interval. Decoder reached EOF; no final-frame display duration was inferred from FPS. These unbracketed tails remain unannotated, and all proposed boundaries stay within observed actual PTS.

v_c_b_183 is threshold-sensitive: only about 2.124 seconds are retained in its first window. Human adjudication of onset could change eligibility. This audit is not a mandate to extend any original accepted interval.

All VID remains one unresolved training-only actor/session cohort. Consent and media-rights records are author/publisher-reported; no independent participant-release or complete non-copyright-rights clearance is established. Evidence stays local and ignored.
